user_prompt: What is the effect of exercise therapy, compared with control (no treatment, placebo, waiting list or health educational material, including exercise plus a co-intervention versus that co-intervention alone), on functional ability in the short term (up to 3 months) in people with patellofemoral pain syndrome? Functional ability should be measured with knee-function questionnaires (e.g. Anterior Knee Pain Scale/Kujala, FIQ, WOMAC, Lysholm), preferring the AKPS/Kujala when a study reports more than one.
